ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (27) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Божество» (bozhestvo, 'deity') is 'the deity' and «законы добра» (zakony dobra) 'the laws of good'; the Chinese saying keeps the word «шу» (shu) as printed. The Deuteronomy passage is translated from Tolstoy's Russian wording, not from an English Bible.

Source observation: [10] «что бы» (chto by) is printed as two words where the sense requires «чтобы» (chtoby, 'that'): «чего мы не хотим, что бы нам делали» ('what we do not want done to us'); translated in that sense.
